summary: Jet.AI Inc. filed an 8-K on July 13, 2026, reporting the completion of a spin-off and merger. Jet.AI transferred its fractional and jet card business to SpinCo, distributed SpinCo shares pro-rata to Jet.AI stockholders as of July 6, 2026, and then merged SpinCo into flyExclusive, with SpinCo surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. Shareholders received flyExclusive Class A common stock as merger consideration. An Amendment No. 5 adjusted the final Purchase Price calculation, which will determine post-closing issuance of Reserve Shares or Additional Merger Consideration Shares. Watch for the eventual distribution of those contingent shares and post-close integration updates.
